name: pokeflex-v02 mechanism ladder
status: POST-HOC and NOT BLIND. Motivated by v01's observed failure on the unloading phase (measured force drops faster after the peak than every v01 model predicts; reports/pokeflex-v01/RESULTS.md finding 5). The v01 held-out outcomes have been unsealed and their aggregate scores, per-object tables and comparison videos have been seen by the people designing this ladder. No new data; the same 8 objects, calibration windows and held-out pokes as v01. Honesty measures: everything below is fixed before any v02 parameter is fitted; rung selection uses calibration evidence only; every prediction file and the code are hashed into a manifest that is committed before any v02 held-out scoring; the scorer refuses files that do not match the committed manifest; anything chosen after seeing a v02 held-out score is reported as such.

data.fitting_data: Exactly the v01 calibration window (pfx_common.calibration_force: offset-corrected force 3-vectors of every calibration-window frame; pokes that start in geometric contact excluded as in v01) and the v01 surface term (protocol chamfer_excl_tool of every 2nd calibration frame). No held-out frame is used for fitting. Fits are per object.
data.held_out: pfx_common.heldout_pokes (the v01 held-out set). Scored on the common set of pokes every compared method predicted (expected: the same 161 as v01).
data.forward_model_inputs: The existing v01 quasi-static FEM simulations runs/pokeflex-v01/sims/<obj>/<take>-p<k>-nu<nu>.npz (one per poke and nu at E_REF; force proportional to E). No new FEM is run unless the escalation rule fires. Same snapped-simulation rule and held-out nu fallbacks as v01 pfx_ours.run_predict.

rungs.M0: v01 'ours', frozen. Its sealed predictions (runs/pokeflex-v01/pred/ours, verified by scripts/pokeflex_stageb/verify_full.py) are scored; it is not re-run. For calibration evidence only, its likelihood is recomputed by the v02 code (nu x log-E grid; must reproduce the v01 posterior).
rungs.M1: M0 + rate dependence: quasi-linear viscoelasticity with ONE Prony term applied to the elastic force history x(t) = (E/E_REF) F_sim(t) of each poke: F(t) = int G(t-s) dx(s), G(t) = g_inf + g1 exp(-t/tau1), G(0) = 1 (E is the instantaneous modulus), g_inf = 1 - g1. Recursive exact-for-piecewise-linear-x update on the 30 fps frame clock (dt = 1/30 s), relaxed state at the poke's start frame. Unilateral contact: if the predicted force component along -approach is <= 0 the whole predicted force is 0 (contact lost during unloading); the internal state keeps following x. Surface = the elastic surface (posterior mean of the sims' surfaces, as M0, with M1's own nu posterior); no contact-loss surface lag is modelled.
rungs.M1b: Pre-registered SENSITIVITY variant of M1 with two Prony terms (tau1 < tau2). Fitted, predicted and scored, but not a rung of the ladder and not eligible for selection.
rungs.M2: M1 + learned contact compliance under the tool: a series compliance (local contact layer reduced to a linear spring k_c) in series with the viscoelastic body. Body depth u = d - delta_c, delta_c = f/k_c, f = force along -approach; f and u are solved per frame (bisection, unique for monotone F_e), sequentially with the M1 Prony state. F_e at depth u from the poke's own simulation: F_sim(frame) scaled by the ratio of the poke's loading-branch along-force table at u and at d (exactly M1 when k_c -> infinity). Surface: sim surface of the frame plus [S(u) - S(d)], S = loading-branch surface table interpolated in depth (the dent is shallower by delta_c). Unilateral contact as M1; when contact is lost u = d.
rungs.M3: M2 + learned compliant support: the whole object translates by delta_s = f/k_s along the approach axis. In force alone k_c and k_s enter only through k_eff = 1/(1/k_c + 1/k_s) (exactly confounded; patch-roles step-1 finding). Parametrised by k_eff and the support fraction r = k_eff/k_s in [0,1] (delta_s = r f/k_eff, delta_c = (1-r) f/k_eff); r is identified only by the surface term. Surface = M2 surface at u = d - f/k_eff, translated by delta_s along the approach axis.

priors_and_grids.E: log-uniform on [1e2, 1e7] Pa, v01 grid of 401 log-spaced points (0.0125 decade). M0/M1/M1b use the full grid (force linear in E after clipping, closed form). M2/M3 are nonlinear in E and use the window of that same grid with log10 E in [log10 E_M0 - 0.25, log10 E_M0 + 1.25] (121 points, E_M0 = v01 posterior mean); prior mass per point stays 1/401. If the posterior mass in the outer 3 points of either window edge exceeds 1e-3 the window is extended by 0.5 decade on that side and refitted (recorded).
priors_and_grids.tau: log-uniform on [0.03, 30] s, 13 points (0.25 decade). M1b: all pairs tau1 < tau2 from this grid.
priors_and_grids.g: uniform on [0, 0.95], 19 cell midpoints 0.025..0.925. M1b: (g1, g2) from the same midpoints with g1 + g2 <= 0.95.
priors_and_grids.k_eff: (M2: k_c; M3: k_eff) log-uniform on [1e2, 1e5] N/m, 13 points (0.25 decade).
priors_and_grids.prior_independence: independent across parameters; uniform weight per grid cell (cell widths equal in the stated scale).

likelihood.force: Gaussian on the calibration force 3-vectors, every calibration frame (v01).
likelihood.surface: Gaussian on chamfer_excl_tool (mm) of every 2nd calibration frame (v01). For M2/M3 the chamfer of the shifted/translated surface is precomputed per frame on a grid of body-depth reduction Delta = d - u in {0,2,4,7,11,16,23,32,45} mm and support translation delta_s in {0,2,4,7,11,16,23,32} mm and bilinearly interpolated (clamped at the grid edge, the fraction of posterior mass at the clamp is reported). Delta = delta_s = 0 reproduces the v01 surface term exactly.
likelihood.posterior_for_prediction: As v01: plug-in noise from the rung's own best fit (sigma_F^2 = min SSE_F/n_F over the rung's grid, sigma_S^2 = min SSE_S/n_S), untempered. Predictions use the posterior over the grid.
likelihood.evidence_for_selection: Log marginal likelihood on the grid with noise FIXED across rungs at M0's v01 plug-in values (fit.json noise_force_N, noise_surface_mm) and each term tempered by n_eff/n to account for frame-to-frame correlation: n_eff = n (1 - rho)/(1 + rho), rho = lag-1 autocorrelation of M0's calibration residuals (force: along-approach residual of the v01 posterior-mean calibration fit; surface: per-frame chamfer minus its mean), clipped to [0, 0.95], per object. Also reported (not used for the decision): BIC with n_eff and the untempered evidence.

selection_rule: Decided on calibration evidence only, before any held-out v02 score. Sequential: M1 is accepted over M0 if the log evidence summed over the 8 objects improves by > 3 nats; M2 over M1 likewise; M3 over M2 likewise. The selected v02 model is the last rung of the unbroken accepted chain from M0. Per-object evidence differences are reported. All rungs are predicted and scored regardless (ladder study).
predictions: runs/pokeflex-v02/pred/<rung>/<Obj>/<take>-p<k>.{npz,json} in the v01 format (frames, force, surf_V, surf_F, risk) + fit.json per object. Posterior mean over grid points taken in descending posterior mass until 0.999 cumulative mass or 600 points (retained mass recorded). Risk = posterior-predictive P(force RMSE > 2 N) as v01 (2000 draws, plug-in noise).
manifest: runs/pokeflex-v02/pred/MANIFEST.sha256.json: sha256 of every v02 prediction file and of every file in scripts/pokeflex_v02/; copied to reports/pokeflex-v02/MANIFEST.sha256.json and committed together with the code and this protocol BEFORE any v02 held-out scoring. The scorer requires the committed manifest to be byte-identical to the report copy, every file hash to match, and scripts/pokeflex_stageb/verify_full.py to pass.

metrics.protocol: pfx_score.score_poke unchanged: force_rmse_N (3-vector), force_along_rmse_N, chamfer_excl_tool_mm, chamfer_mm (every frame).
metrics.contact: contact_metrics.py logic (tool_region_mm, force_contact_rmse_N, force_contact_along_rmse_N, peak_force_err_N, peak_force_rel).
metrics.PRIMARY: unloading_along_rmse_N: RMSE of the force component along -approach over the scored frames strictly after the frame of maximum geometric contact depth (pfx_common.contact_depth, free input) up to the poke end.
metrics.secondary_new: loading_along_rmse_N (scored frames up to and including the max-depth frame); hysteresis_err_mJ = |A_pred - A_meas|, A = sum over consecutive scored frames of the trapezoid 0.5 (F_n + F_n+1)(d_n+1 - d_n) of the along-approach force against geometric contact depth (net work = enclosed loop area, mJ).
metrics.aggregation: mean over pokes per object, mean over objects; paired per-poke comparisons of each rung vs M0 and vs the previous rung: wins/losses, median difference, mean difference with a 95% bootstrap CI over pokes clustered by take (10000 resamples, seed 0). PhysTwin (stage B) is an external reference from its manifest-checked predictions.
metrics.success_primary: A rung improves unloading if the 95% cluster-bootstrap CI of its mean paired unloading_along_rmse_N difference vs M0 lies entirely below 0.
metrics.no_surface_degradation: A rung does not degrade the surface if (a) its mean-over-objects chamfer_excl_tool_mm exceeds M0's by at most 0.05 mm AND (b) the upper end of the 95% cluster-bootstrap CI of the mean paired chamfer_excl_tool_mm difference vs M0 is <= 0.10 mm. The reconstruction noise floor is ~0.7 mm (v01 protocol).

identifiability: Report per object the posterior mean/sd of log10 E, nu, tau, g, k_c, k_s, r; for M3 the posterior correlation of log10 k_c and log10 k_s and the posterior of r against its uniform prior (posterior sd / prior sd). The surface separates M2 from M3 only if the r posterior is materially narrower than its prior.
escalation: Full spatial Gaussian support/contact patches need new FEM. Only if M2 or M3 is accepted by the calibration rule AND improves the primary metric on held-out; then restricted to calibration pokes + a small held-out subset, otherwise only recommended.
compute: No GPU. <= 8 CPU threads total, jobs as capped systemd user units pfx2-*.
licence: PokeFlex is non-commercial/no redistribution: only code, this protocol, the manifest, aggregate score JSON and the report are committed.
